items.name: Vårpengeurt
items.observations: Original pedagogical botanical illustration of Noccaea caerulescens showing a basal rosette of glaucous spathulate leaves, a slender erect stem with smaller cauline leaves, a cluster of white to pale lilac four-petaled flowers with purplish anthers and distinctive V-notched heart-shaped silicles. Reviewed over a solid black background.
items.limitations: Hand illustrated depiction, not a photograph, herbarium voucher or a stand-alone identification key. Pod and leaf venation are simplified.
